verdict.rationale: Radar lets users configure rules (block, request 3DS, allow, auto-pause payouts) and risk settings that then run automatically on every payment attempt, with no manual action needed. These are a narrow kind of background automation: event-triggered fraud rules limited to payment screening, not general-purpose autonomous workflows. missing for 10: general-purpose or scheduled automations beyond rule-based payment screening, agent-driven autonomous actions, documentation of automation setup depth, independent hands-on corroboration.
